note: ADULTS ONLY (no children). Adult-only park on the south edge of Sedalia on four acres of woods and open space, with storm shelters and a pavilion; takes overnight, short and long-term stays. --Claude
summary: Operator's site: 50 sites, 30/50A + sewer, heated shower house with laundry, open year round, adult only, reservations by phone. No nightly rate posted anywhere on the operator's site, no booking engine; the operator now markets long-term stays for RVs and single-wide mobile homes and says it caters to traveling workers and retirees - long-stay test 2 fails.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 2, workforce character): the operator's site posts no rate of any kind and there is no booking engine; it says 'Now adding long term stays for RV's and single wide mobile homes' and 'adult only long and short term park', and the owner replied to a Google review (6 months ago): 'We cater to traveling workers and retirees.' Five tests: (1) seasonal-only sites - not stated; (2) posted nightly rate - NONE (fail); (3) homes/lots for sale - none for sale, but mobile homes taken as long-term stays; (4) share sold nightly - no engine to check; one review (11 months ago) 'stayed here over the holiday weekend'; (5) short stays by approval - not stated.
